description: This is a shell script (bash) utility for accessing and visualizing logs related to the VibeTunnel system on macOS. It provides command-line options to filter, search, format, and output logs from the macOS unified logging system, specifically targeting the subsystem 'ai.openclaw'. The script includes functions for displaying help, listing recent categories, handling sudo permissions, and managing log retrieval either interactively or for export.

methods.name: handle_sudo_error
methods.description: Displays instructions for configuring passwordless sudo for the log command when permission issues occur.

methods.name: show_usage
methods.description: Displays the usage/help information for the clawlog script.

methods.name: list_categories
methods.description: Fetches and displays recent log categories associated with the 'ai.openclaw' subsystem from the last hour.

methods.name: escape_predicate_literal
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings to safely embed in macOS log predicates.
